book.kogasa_addiction.entry.introduction: Welcome to the Kogasa Equipment Guide
This mod adds growth, reinforcement, absorption, and character abilities to selected weapons, tools, armor, and ranged equipment. This guide explains how these systems work together.
Exact values can be changed in the config. If a server administrator has customized the settings, follow the in-game values and server rules.
1. Craft or obtain a Kogasa equipment item. $(br)2. Reinforce it in an anvil with a material accepted by its equipment category. $(br)3. After reaching the configured reinforcement threshold, the item can gain growth from supported actions.

4. Combine an ability ingot with equipment in an anvil to infuse its character ability. $(br)5. Hold the modifier keys shown in the item's tooltip to inspect growth, reinforcement, and ability information.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.name: The Growth System
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page1: Growth is stored on each equipment item; it is not a player-wide level. Growth unlocks according to the item's reinforcement count and the growthUnlockReinforcements config option.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page2: Current supported growth triggers include eligible player attacks against entities, block breaking, certain tool actions, and Kogasa armor worn when the player takes damage. In this version, bow/crossbow firing has not yet been connected to the generic growth event; update this page when ranged growth is implemented.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.reinforcemen: Place the equipment in the left anvil slot and a reinforcement material accepted by its category tag in the right slot. A successful operation raises the reinforcement level and absorbs part of the material's base value according to the current rules.
The material's registry ID is recorded. The same equipment cannot absorb the same registered item type more than once. The reinforcement cap, experience cost, and absorption ratios are configurable.
Vanilla repair or enchantment combination for the same damageable item is allowed to take priority. If no custom result appears, check that the right-hand item belongs to the correct category.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_slot: Equipment starts with one ability slot. The second slot unlocks when growth reaches growthForSecondAbilitySlot; the default threshold is 0.5 (50%).

An ability ingot can only infuse an ability the item does not already have. If no slot is available or the ability is already present, the anvil will not produce a successful result. The default infusion cost is 3 experience levels; check the config for the actual value.
Infuse Aya's ability by combining Aya Ingot with equipment in an anvil. The ability records newly encountered mob types, mined block types, and damage types the player takes, increasing News Value.
News Value contributes to some equipment multipliers. Ranged hits can also trigger Aya's Speed and Haste effects; their duration and level are configurable.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.cirno_abilit: Cirno's melee ability can apply Slowness to the target and has a smaller chance to slow the user as well. The chance, duration, and level are configurable.

When equipment with Cirno's ability is about to break from durability loss, the revival feature can consume a configured amount of growth and prevent that durability loss from breaking the item, provided the feature is enabled and enough growth remains. The item is left at extremely low durability.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.koishi_abili: Koishi's ability can trigger critical hits according to the configured chance and multiplier. Ranged weapons use separate ranged-critical settings, and certain targets may receive additional multipliers.
Koishi Ingot acquisition is tied to killing Ghasts with reflected fireballs. The required kill count is configured by koishiGhastKillsRequired.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.kogasa_abili: Kogasa's ability adds a bonus to the overall multiplier based on reinforcement level. The per-level bonus is controlled by kogasaReinforcementMultiplierPerLevel.
Ranged hit-streak bonuses are also configurable. Check the current settings for the bonus, streak reset time, and maximum streak.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.equipment_in: The current equipment set includes Kogasa's sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. They share the common equipment-growth data structure.
The effects of reinforcement and growth depend on equipment type and config. Use the item's tooltip to inspect its current multiplier, reinforcement, growth, and abilities.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_ingo: Aya Ingot, Cirno Ingot, Koishi Ingot, and Kogasa Ingot correspond to the Aya, Cirno, Koishi, and Kogasa abilities. Ability ingots are primarily used for anvil infusion.
Each ingot has a different acquisition method, and some methods are controlled by config toggles or probabilities. If a source is disabled, check the world's server config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ranged_basic: Aya's bow and crossbow retain the main interaction patterns of vanilla bows and crossbows and use the shared equipment data system. Bow draw states, crossbow loading states, and enchantments are still handled by their respective vanilla mechanics.

Ranged abilities include Aya's Speed/Haste after a hit, Cirno's Slowness effect, Koishi's ranged critical hits, and Kogasa's hit-streak bonus. Effects depend on the ability infused into the equipment and the config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.aya_arrow.pa: Aya Arrow is a dedicated arrow item that can be used by Aya's bow or crossbow. Its custom projectile returns the corresponding Aya Arrow item when pickup rules allow it.
Aya Arrow supports the mod's tipped-arrow recipe mechanism. Refer to the recipes registered in the current version for the available effects.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.admin_comman: The following commands require permission level 2 (usually an operator) and are intended for testing and troubleshooting, not normal survival play: $(br)$(li)/kogasa info$(br)$(li)/kogasa grow <amount>$(br)$(li)/kogasa reinforce <item>$(br)$(li)/kogasa addability <aya|cirno|koishi|kogasa>

Other debug commands include /kogasa removeability <ability>, /kogasa clearabilities, /kogasa reset, /kogasa enchant <enchantment> <level>, /kogasa growenchant <count>, /kogasa newsvalue <amount>, /kogasa setnewsvalue <value>, /kogasa setammo, and /kogasa clearammo.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.troubleshoot: No anvil reinforcement result: make sure the left slot contains this mod's equipment, the right-hand material matches the correct category tag, and that item type has not already been absorbed by this equipment.

Ability infusion fails: confirm that the ingot and equipment are valid, the equipment does not already have the ability, and a slot is available. The growth threshold and experience cost are configurable.
Ranged ability does not trigger: check that the corresponding ranged ability toggle is enabled, the held weapon is this mod's equipment, and the target is not excluded from the effect.

book.kogasa_addiction.field_guide.landin: Welcome to Kogasa's Equipment Growth Guide! $(br2)This guide covers equipment growth, anvil reinforcement, material absorption, character abilities, ranged weapons, and admin debugging tools. Some values are configurable; always refer to the behavior of your current game.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.equipment_in: Kogasa's sword is crafted from Kogasa Ingots and a stick. The other tools and armor also use Kogasa Ingots as their main material.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ranged_basic: Aya's bow uses Aya Ingots and string. The crossbow recipe also uses Aya Ingots together with an iron ingot, string, and a tripwire hook.
